details: Reporter (first v2 hardware read) says frequencies written in zone 2 or 3 land in zone 1, and edits cannot span zones before a write. Offline bridge replay places a zone 2 edit at channel 65 and CPS V1.17 uses the same zone*64+slot IDs. Added EnZone (0x73 bit 2) handling; need the reporter's image and what the radio shows.
summary: Writes to zones 2-3 reported in zone 1
